verses.original: קִרְב֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ הַקְשִׁ֑יבוּ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּשְׁמַ֤ע וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ תֵּבֵ֖ל וְכָל־ צֶאֱצָאֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: qir·ḇū ḡō·w·yim liš·mō·a‘ haq·šî·ḇū ū·lə·’um·mîm hā·’ā·reṣ tiš·ma‘ ū·mə·lō·’āh tê·ḇêl wə·ḵāl ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·hā
verses.literal: Come near O nations to listen pay attention O peoples Let the earth hear and all that fills it the world and all that springs from it

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַֽיהוָה֙ קֶ֤צֶף עַל־ עַל־ כָּל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֵמָ֖ה צְבָאָ֑ם הֶחֱרִימָ֖ם נְתָנָ֥ם לַטָּֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh qe·ṣep̄ ‘al- ‘al- kāl- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim wə·ḥê·māh ṣə·ḇā·’ām he·ḥĕ·rî·mām nə·ṯā·nām laṭ·ṭā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: - The LORD is angry with . . . all . . . the nations and furious with all their armies He will devote them to destruction He will give them over to slaughter

verses.original: וְחַלְלֵיהֶ֣ם יֻשְׁלָ֔כוּ בָאְשָׁ֑ם וּפִגְרֵיהֶ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה הָרִ֖ים וְנָמַ֥סּוּ מִדָּמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥal·lê·hem yuš·lā·ḵū ḇā·’ə·šām ū·p̄iḡ·rê·hem ya·‘ă·leh hā·rîm wə·nā·mas·sū mid·dā·mām
verses.literal: Their slain will be left unburied and the stench of their corpses will rise the mountains will flow with their blood

verses.original: כָּל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָמַ֙קּוּ֙ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְנָגֹ֥לּוּ כַסֵּ֖פֶר צְבָאָ֣ם וְכָל־ יִבּ֔וֹל כִּנְבֹ֤ל עָלֶה֙ מִגֶּ֔פֶן וּכְנֹבֶ֖לֶת מִתְּאֵנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·ma·yim wə·nā·maq·qū haš·šā·mā·yim wə·nā·ḡōl·lū ḵas·sê·p̄er ṣə·ḇā·’ām wə·ḵāl yib·bō·wl kin·ḇōl ‘ā·leh mig·ge·p̄en ū·ḵə·nō·ḇe·leṯ mit·tə·’ê·nāh
verses.literal: All the stars of heaven will be dissolved The skies will be rolled up like a scroll and all their stars . . . will fall like withered leaves from the vine like foliage from the fig tree

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חַרְבִּ֑י רִוְּתָ֥ה בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִנֵּה֙ תֵּרֵ֔ד עַל־ אֱד֣וֹם וְעַל־ עַ֥ם חֶרְמִ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥar·bî riw·wə·ṯāh ḇaš·šā·ma·yim hin·nêh tê·rêḏ ‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·‘al- ‘am ḥer·mî lə·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens then it will come down upon Edom upon the people I have devoted to destruction

verses.original: חֶ֣רֶב לַיהוָ֞ה מָלְאָ֥ה דָם֙ הֻדַּ֣שְׁנָה מֵחֵ֔לֶב מִדַּ֤ם כָּרִים֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים מֵחֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת אֵילִ֑ים כִּ֣י לַֽיהוָה֙ זֶ֤בַח בְּבָצְרָ֔ה גָּד֖וֹל וְטֶ֥בַח בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ Yah·weh mā·lə·’āh ḏām hud·daš·nāh mê·ḥê·leḇ mid·dam kā·rîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm mê·ḥê·leḇ kil·yō·wṯ ’ê·lîm kî Yah·weh ze·ḇaḥ bə·ḇā·ṣə·rāh gā·ḏō·wl wə·ṭe·ḇaḥ bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood It drips with fat with the blood of lambs and goats with the fat of the kidneys of rams For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah a great slaughter in the land of Edom

verses.original: רְאֵמִים֙ וְיָרְד֤וּ עִמָּ֔ם וּפָרִ֖ים עִם־ אַבִּירִ֑ים אַרְצָם֙ וְרִוְּתָ֤ה מִדָּ֔ם וַעֲפָרָ֖ם יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃ מֵחֵ֥לֶב
verses.transliteration: rə·’ê·mîm wə·yā·rə·ḏū ‘im·mām ū·p̄ā·rîm ‘im- ’ab·bî·rîm ’ar·ṣām wə·riw·wə·ṯāh mid·dām wa·‘ă·p̄ā·rām yə·ḏuš·šān mê·ḥê·leḇ
verses.literal: And the wild oxen will fall with them the young bulls with the strong [ones] Their land will be drenched with blood and their soil will be soaked with fat

verses.original: כִּ֛י לַֽיהוָ֑ה י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם שְׁנַ֥ת שִׁלּוּמִ֖ים לְרִ֥יב צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh yō·wm nā·qām šə·naṯ šil·lū·mîm lə·rîḇ ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: For the LORD has a day of vengeance a year of recompense for the cause of Zion

verses.original: נְחָלֶ֙יהָ֙ וְנֶהֶפְכ֤וּ לְזֶ֔פֶת וַעֲפָרָ֖הּ לְגָפְרִ֑ית אַרְצָ֔הּ וְהָיְתָ֣ה בֹּעֵרָֽה׃ לְזֶ֖פֶת
verses.transliteration: nə·ḥā·le·hā wə·ne·hep̄·ḵū lə·ze·p̄eṯ wa·‘ă·p̄ā·rāh lə·ḡā·p̄ə·rîṯ ’ar·ṣāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh bō·‘ê·rāh lə·ze·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: [Edom’s] streams will be turned to tar and her soil to sulfur her land will become a blazing pitch

verses.original: לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וְיוֹמָם֙ לַ֤יְלָה עֲשָׁנָ֑הּ יַעֲלֶ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֖ם מִדּ֤וֹר לָדוֹר֙ תֶּחֱרָ֔ב אֵ֥ין לְנֵ֣צַח נְצָחִ֔ים עֹבֵ֖ר בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯiḵ·beh wə·yō·w·mām lay·lāh ‘ă·šā·nāh ya·‘ă·leh lə·‘ō·w·lām mid·dō·wr lā·ḏō·wr te·ḥĕ·rāḇ ’ên lə·nê·ṣaḥ nə·ṣā·ḥîm ‘ō·ḇêr bāh
verses.literal: It will not be quenched day or night Its smoke will ascend forever From generation to generation it will lie desolate no one will ever again . . . pass through it

verses.original: קָאַ֣ת וְקִפּ֔וֹד וִירֵשׁ֙וּהָ֙ וְיַנְשׁ֥וֹף וְעֹרֵ֖ב יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָ֑הּ וְנָטָ֥ה עָלֶ֛יהָ קַֽו־ תֹ֖הוּ וְאַבְנֵי־ בֹֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·’aṯ wə·qip·pō·wḏ wî·rê·šū·hā wə·yan·šō·wp̄ wə·‘ō·rêḇ yiš·kə·nū- ḇāh wə·nā·ṭāh ‘ā·le·hā qaw- ṯō·hū wə·’aḇ·nê- ḇō·hū
verses.literal: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it and the great owl and raven will dwell in it The LORD will stretch out over [Edom] a measuring line of chaos and a plumb line of destruction

verses.original: וְאֵֽין־ שָׁ֖ם חֹרֶ֥יהָ יִקְרָ֑אוּ מְלוּכָ֣ה וְכָל־ שָׂרֶ֖יהָ יִ֥הְיוּ אָֽפֶס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ên- šām ḥō·re·hā yiq·rā·’ū mə·lū·ḵāh wə·ḵāl śā·re·hā yih·yū ’ā·p̄es
verses.literal: No . . . nobles will be left to proclaim a king and all her princes will come to nothing

verses.original: אַרְמְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וְעָלְתָ֤ה סִירִ֔ים בְּמִבְצָרֶ֑יהָ קִמּ֥וֹשׂ וָח֖וֹחַ וְהָיְתָה֙ נְוֵ֣ה תַנִּ֔ים חָצִ֖יר לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·mə·nō·ṯe·hā wə·‘ā·lə·ṯāh sî·rîm bə·miḇ·ṣā·re·hā qim·mō·wś wā·ḥō·w·aḥ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh nə·wêh ṯan·nîm ḥā·ṣîr liḇ·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns her fortresses with thistles and briers She will become a haunt for jackals an abode vvv for ostriches

verses.original: צִיִּים֙ אֶת־ וּפָגְשׁ֤וּ אִיִּ֔ים וְשָׂעִ֖יר יִקְרָ֑א עַל־ רֵעֵ֣הוּ אַךְ־ שָׁם֙ לִּילִ֔ית הִרְגִּ֣יעָה וּמָצְאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ מָנֽוֹחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yîm ’eṯ- ū·p̄ā·ḡə·šū ’î·yîm wə·śā·‘îr yiq·rā ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū ’aḵ- šām lî·lîṯ hir·gî·‘āh ū·mā·ṣə·’āh lāh mā·nō·w·aḥ
verses.literal: The desert creatures - will meet with hyenas and one wild goat will call to another vvv There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה קִפּוֹז֙ קִנְּנָ֤ה וַתְּמַלֵּ֔ט וּבָקְעָ֖ה וְדָגְרָ֣ה בְצִלָּ֑הּ אַךְ־ שָׁ֛ם דַיּ֖וֹת נִקְבְּצ֥וּ אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šām·māh qip·pō·wz qin·nə·nāh wat·tə·mal·lêṭ ū·ḇā·qə·‘āh wə·ḏā·ḡə·rāh ḇə·ṣil·lāh ’aḵ- šām ḏay·yō·wṯ niq·bə·ṣū ’iš·šāh rə·‘ū·ṯāh
verses.literal: There the owl will make her nest she will lay and hatch her eggs and gather her brood under her shadow Even there the birds of prey will gather each with its mate

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֨וּ מֵֽעַל־ וּֽקְרָ֔אוּ סֵ֤פֶר יְהוָה֙ לֹ֣א אַחַ֤ת מֵהֵ֙נָּה֙ נֶעְדָּ֔רָה אִשָּׁ֥ה לֹ֣א פָקָ֑דוּ רְעוּתָ֖הּ כִּֽי־ ה֣וּא צִוָּ֔ה פִי֙ ה֥וּא קִבְּצָֽן׃ וְרוּח֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: dir·šū mê·‘al- ū·qə·rā·’ū sê·p̄er Yah·weh lō ’a·ḥaṯ mê·hên·nāh ne‘·dā·rāh ’iš·šāh lō p̄ā·qā·ḏū rə·‘ū·ṯāh kî- hū ṣiw·wāh p̄î hū qib·bə·ṣān wə·rū·ḥōw
verses.literal: Search . . . and read the scroll of the LORD Not one of these will go missing not one . . . will lack her mate because He has ordered it by His mouth and He will gather them by His Spirit

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־ הִפִּ֤יל לָהֶן֙ גּוֹרָ֔ל וְיָד֛וֹ חִלְּקַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם בַּקָּ֑ו יִֽירָשׁ֔וּהָ עַד־ עוֹלָם֙ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָֽהּ׃ס לְד֥וֹר וָד֖וֹר
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hip·pîl lā·hen gō·w·rāl wə·yā·ḏōw ḥil·lə·qat·tāh lā·hem baq·qāw yî·rā·šū·hā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām yiš·kə·nū- ḇāh lə·ḏō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: He has allotted their portion His hand has distributed it by measure They will possess it forever . . . they will dwell in it from generation to generation
